title: Pocketwire Rewards Member Guide: Redeeming the Whole Balance for a Digital Gift Card
content:
A Pocketwire Rewards member can redeem the whole points balance for a digital gift card of a brand the member names, while the membership is active and none of the balance is pending.

## Conditions

1. Points can be redeemed only while the membership status is active, and only redeemable points can be redeemed.
2. A whole-balance gift card redemption is available only when none of the points balance is still pending, so that the whole balance is redeemable. The redemption is booked as one entry carrying the gift card brand the member names.
3. A whole-balance gift card redemption is not valued until the ledger carries a clawback entry for the latest merchant refund of an earning purchase posted within the clawback window. While the ledger carries no such clawback entry, a whole-balance gift card redemption is not valued.

## Availability at a glance (hypothetical memberships)

| Membership status | Points still pending | Whole-balance gift card redemption available |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | Yes |
| active | some points credited within the pending period | No |
| suspended | any | No |

## Redemption tool: redeem_points_gift_card_91c84320

Situation of use and capability. The tool redeems the member's own Pocketwire Rewards points for a digital gift card. It books one gift card redemption entry on the member's points ledger, dated today, for the points and gift card brand given and with the gift card face value given, and subtracts the points from the points balance. The redemption appears in the app's points activity with its redemption reference, and the digital gift card is delivered within the tier's fulfilment period.

How it is invoked. `redeem_points_gift_card_91c84320` is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, confirming the redemption in person.

Parameters.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the rewards membership reference number of the member redeeming, as read out by the agent from the rewards membership lookup | reference number |
| `points` | the points redeemed, as told by the agent | a whole integer number of points, zero or positive |
| `payee_name` | the gift card brand exactly as the member named it in the conversation | verbatim, character for character with its original wording and punctuation |
| `cash_value` | the gift card face value, as told by the agent | USD, 2 decimal places |

Return. A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the text "redeemed" when the redemption was booked), `redemption_reference` (the redemption reference shown in the app), `rewards_entry_id` (reference number of the new points entry), `points` (integer points redeemed), `payee_name` (gift card brand), `cash_value` (face value in USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (redemption date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (the integer points balance left once the redemption is booked).

Illustration (hypothetical input). A member who named the brand "Northwind Books" runs the tool with that `payee_name` copied as said; the receipt shows `status` "redeemed", a `redemption_reference` and the remaining `points_balance`.
